name: singlet_perturbation_escaper_classification
title: Classify perturbed versus escaper guide cells
description: Labels each guide-carrying cell of a CRISPR knockout screen as perturbed (KO) or non-perturbed (NP) and reports per-target escape fractions. The default mixscape method projects kNN non-targeting perturbation signatures onto a per-target direction and fits a mixture with the non-targeting component fixed; mixscale returns a continuous score only. Needs per-cell target labels, non-targeting controls, replicate labels, unscaled log-normalised expression and PCA; writes class, posterior, signature and escape-rate members. Not for CRISPRa screens, guides without a target, or deciding whether a target has any effect.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: mixscape gives KO/NP calls and posteriors; mixscale returns a graded score and no class.

targets.description: Target genes to classify; an empty list classifies every target with guide cells.

design.description: Column names, control label, split key, layer and embedding of the input.

target_key.description: obs column with each cell's target gene.

control_label.description: Target value of non-targeting control cells.

split_by.description: obs column; non-targeting neighbours and mixture fits stay within one level.

layer.description: Unscaled log-normalised layer used for signatures and DE tests.

embedding_key.description: obsm key of the embedding for neighbour search; computed from the layer when absent.

neighbourhood.description: Non-targeting neighbours used to build perturbation signatures.

n_neighbors.description: Non-targeting neighbours averaged per cell for the signature.

n_dims.description: Embedding dimensions used for the neighbour search.

exclude_self.description: Remove each non-targeting cell from its own neighbour set.

min_de_genes.description: Fewer direction genes than this labels all cells of the target NP.

logfc_threshold.description: Minimum absolute log fold change of direction genes.

pval_cutoff.description: Adjusted p-value cut-off of direction genes.

exclude_target.description: Drop the target gene from direction genes and mixture inputs.

split_fraction.description: Share of cells used to select direction genes; 0 disables cross-fitting.

mixscape.description: Options of the two-component mixture call.

iter_num.description: Maximum relabelling iterations of direction and mixture.

posterior_prior.description: pooled_lambda uses the fitted mixing weight; equal reproduces the Seurat posterior.

posterior_threshold.description: Posterior above which a guide cell is called KO.

min_cells.description: Targets with fewer KO cells in an iteration are labelled all NP.

scale.description: Z-score direction genes before the mixture fit.

mixscale.description: Options of the standardised projection score.

max_de_genes.description: Largest number of direction genes used for the score.

clip.description: Absolute clip of each direction gene's z-score before projection.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for mixture starts; the mixscale path is deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/mixscape_class. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs. Keys: method, n_targets, n_targets_all_np, n_guide_cells, fraction_ko, targets_not_converged. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
